overview.title: Query public Gemini learning resources
overview.lede: Read-only JSON endpoints for searching and inspecting indexed public Google Skills Gemini courses, learning paths, and hands-on labs without an API key.
overview.baseUrlLede: All endpoints are public read-only GET routes under this origin and require no API key or bearer token.
overview.quickStartHeading: Fetch your first page of resources
overview.quickStartLede: Run this curl command in your terminal to retrieve up to five indexed learning resources.
overview.endpointsLede: Select a catalog route to view its parameters and response schema, or open the operational routes directly.
overview.tryLede: Choose an endpoint to query the current local snapshot directly from your browser.

conventions.readOnly: Snapshot-backed reads: Every request reads a validated local snapshot and never triggers a crawl or source fetch.
conventions.cursors: Snapshot-scoped pagination: Results are ordered by ascending stable ga_ ID; cursors bind to your active filters and snapshotId, returning 400 on filter mismatch or 409 if the snapshot changed.
conventions.nulls: Explicit empty values: Responses use camelCase and keep all documented fields present, returning null or [] when a fact is unverified or absent on the source page.
conventions.durations: Durations: duration.courseMinutes holds the length of a course or lab, and duration.pathMinutes holds the length of a learning path. videoSeconds is null for this source.
conventions.sources: Canonical source links: Each resource ID (ga_ plus 24 hex characters) hashes its canonical public Google Skills URL, and url plus provenance.sourceUrls link directly to the original pages.
conventions.notExposed: Catalog metadata only: The API does not provide enrollment, learner progress, course or lab text, videos, or images. media is always [], and artwork is always null.

overview.linksLede: Inspect the OpenAPI 3.1 schema, check server health, or view the repository.

resources.title: List and filter learning resources
resources.lede: Search the current snapshot by keyword, learning path, or kind with deterministic cursor pagination.

params.q: Case-insensitive text search across resource titles, summaries, and credential tags such as Skill badge (up to 200 characters).
params.category: Learning path slug from GET /v1/categories (lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens, up to 100 characters).
params.kind: Resource format filter: course, learning-path, or lab.
params.audience: Audience filter shared with the OpenAI Academy API: general, knowledge-workers, developers, leaders, educators, students, admins, or other. Google Skills pages publish no audience, so audiences is [] on every resource.
params.cursor: Opaque pagination token from nextCursor; must be sent with the same filters against the same snapshotId.
params.limit: Maximum number of resources to return per page (1 to {max}, default {default}).

resources.shapeNote: Items are sorted by ascending resource ID so pages stay deterministic within a snapshot.

response.items: Page of matching Resource objects ordered by ascending stable ID.
response.nextCursor: Opaque cursor for the next page of results, or null when no further items match.
response.total: Total number of resources in the snapshot matching the active filters.
response.snapshotId: SHA-256 identifier of the snapshot serving this page.

resources.tryLede: Set optional filters and run a request. Changing any filter resets pagination to the first page.

filters.categoryUnavailable: The learning path list could not be loaded from /v1/categories. You can still run other filters.

resources.empty: No resources in the current snapshot matched these filters. Clear or broaden a filter and run the request again.

resource.title: Fetch a single resource by ID
resource.lede: Fetch full metadata, the course outline or learning path members, duration, and provenance for a single resource ID.
resource.shapeNote: Every documented field is present in the JSON payload; unknown or unverified values are null or empty arrays.

fields.id: Stable identifier: ga_ followed by the first 24 lowercase hex characters of the canonical URL's SHA-256 hash.
fields.title: Official resource title from the public source page.
fields.url: Canonical public destination URL on www.skills.google.
fields.kind: Resource format: course, learning-path, or lab (a timed hands-on exercise).
fields.categoryIds: Slugs of the learning paths that list this resource.
fields.audiences: Normalized audience values. Google Skills pages publish no audience, so this list is empty.
fields.tags: Credential awarded by a course, such as Skill badge, when one exists on the source page.
fields.summary: Short description of the resource, or null when not stated on the source.
fields.level: Difficulty level mapped from Introductory, Intermediate, or Advanced to beginner, intermediate, or advanced, or null when none is stated.
fields.duration: Object with courseMinutes (course or lab length), pathMinutes (learning path length), and videoSeconds (null for this source); values are never combined.
fields.detail: Structured notes: free-text audience, prerequisites and objectives (empty for this source), and ordered sections holding a course's module, lesson, quiz, and lab titles or a learning path's member courses and labs. Lesson and lab text is never copied.
fields.media: Always []: course videos, audio, and documents are never copied or referenced.
fields.artwork: Always null: Google Skills serves one generic share image for every page, so no per-item image exists and nothing is hotlinked or re-hosted.
fields.provenance: Source URLs (the page, catalog listing, and any learning paths listing it), UTC fetch timestamp, normalized metadata SHA-256 hash, and collection method (crawler, manual, or fixture).

resource.idHint: Enter a ga_ resource ID, or select a resource from the Resources page to populate this request.

categories.title: List learning paths
categories.lede: Retrieve the learning path slugs, display labels, and resource counts present in the current snapshot. Each learning path is one category.
categories.shapeNote: Pass any category id as the category query parameter on GET /v1/resources to list the courses and labs in that learning path.

response.items: List of learning paths present in the active snapshot.
response.id: Lowercase slug used as the category query parameter on /v1/resources.
response.label: Learning path title from its public Google Skills page.
response.count: Number of indexed courses and labs the learning path lists in the current snapshot.
response.snapshotId: SHA-256 identifier of the snapshot serving these counts.

categories.resultsHeading: Learning paths in the current snapshot
categories.empty: No learning paths are recorded in the current snapshot.

status.title: Snapshot freshness and coverage status
status.lede: Check whether the active snapshot is fresh, stale, or unavailable, along with refresh timestamps and per-path coverage.

fields.freshness: Snapshot state: fresh, stale, or unavailable. Reports stale when the snapshot is older than 7 days, coverage is incomplete, the latest refresh failed, or the server fell back to a prior snapshot after a read error.
fields.resourceCount: Total number of validated resources in the active snapshot.
fields.coverage: Per-path records reporting categoryId, state (complete, partial, or not-collected), discovered count (member links on the learning path page), and collected count.

status.note: The response also reports snapshotId (active SHA-256 hash or null) and UTC timestamps for generatedAt, lastAttemptAt, and lastSuccessAt; failed refreshes keep serving the last validated snapshot.

notFound.lede: No documentation page matches this URL path.
